<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>Intelligence Report - Social Media Monitoring</title>
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
<link href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/5.15.3/css/all.min.css" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
        :root {
            --primary-dark: #1a1a2e;
            --secondary-dark: #16213e;
            --accent-blue: #007bff;
            --accent-green: #28a745;
            --accent-orange: #ffc107;
            --accent-red: #dc3545;
            --light-gray: #f8f9fa;
            --dark-gray: #343a40;
            --border-radius: 8px;
            --box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
        }
        
        body {
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
            background-color: white;
            color: var(--dark-gray);
            margin: 0;
            padding: 20px;
            max-width: 800px;
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
        }
        
        .header {
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent-blue);
            padding-bottom: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 25px;
        }
        
        .section-title {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            padding-bottom: 8px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
        }
        
        .sentiment-positive {
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }
        
        .sentiment-neutral {
            color: var(--accent-orange);
        }
        
        .sentiment-negative {
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }
        
        .platform-twitter { background-color: #1da1f2; }
        .platform-instagram { background-color: #e1306c; }
        .platform-facebook { background-color: #4267b2; }
        .platform-youtube { background-color: #ff0000; }
        .platform-whatsapp { background-color: #25d366; }
        
        .chip {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 0.85em;
            margin-right: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            color: white;
        }
        
        .post-card {
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--box-shadow);
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }
        
        .post-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }
        
        .chart-container {
            height: 200px;
            position: relative;
        }
        
        .metric-card {
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--box-shadow);
            padding: 20px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        
        .metric-value {
            font-size: 2em;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin: 10px 0;
        }
        
        .metric-label {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #666;
        }
        
        .footer {
            margin-top: 30px;
            padding-top: 15px;
            border-top: 1px solid #eee;
            font-size: 0.85em;
            color: #666;
        }
    </style>
</head>
